summary.verdict: Domain shape and spec foundations are solid (random order, WebMock, transactional fixtures, mocked Identity Platform). What sits below the line is the production hardening: Rails+Ruby are both off support, force_ssl/require_master_key are disabled, there's no health endpoint, the API token compare is timing-vulnerable, and money-moving paths lack idempotency keys. Most of these are 1–3 line fixes — sequenced so each phase unblocks the next.
summary.next_action: Land Phase 1 (deploy safety) within 1–2 days before any further feature work.

findings.title: Ruby and Rails are both EOL
findings.explanation: Brakeman flags both Ruby 3.1.2 (EOL 2025-03-31) and Rails 7.0.4 (EOL 2025-04-01). Neither receives security backports. Any Ruby/Rails CVE published after April 2025 is unpatched.
findings.fix_sketch: Plan upgrade to Ruby 3.3+ and Rails 7.1 or 7.2 LTS.

findings.title: force_ssl disabled in production
findings.explanation: App accepts plain HTTP if any path bypasses Cloud Run's TLS terminator. JWT/auth headers and Stripe customer IDs travel unencrypted in those cases.
findings.fix_sketch: Uncomment. Cloud Run honors X-Forwarded-Proto by default.

findings.title: require_master_key disabled
findings.explanation: App boots without a master key and only fails when the first credential read happens — minutes after a deploy, by which point the bad revision may have served traffic.
findings.fix_sketch: Uncomment. Verify CI env injection has the key set.

findings.title: No health endpoint
findings.explanation: Cloud Run can't probe readiness or gate rollouts; bad revisions receive traffic before they're ready.
findings.fix_sketch: get '/healthz' => 'health#show'; controller does ActiveRecord::Base.connection.execute('SELECT 1') and renders 200.

findings.title: Hardcoded callback secret in production deploy workflow
findings.explanation: Either this exact mock value is what production runs with (callbacks are unauthenticated in practice), or it's overridden later but the workflow shows no override path.
findings.fix_sketch: Move to GCP Secret Manager or GitHub repo secret; reference via ${{ secrets.COMPRESS_VIDEO_CALLBACK_SECRET }}.

findings.title: API token compared with ==

evidence.snippet: raise StandardError, 'Unauthorized Request' unless application_token == extracted_token
evidence.normalized: raise StandardError, 'Unauthorized Request' unless application_token == extracted_token

findings.explanation: Timing-vulnerable on every authenticated request. Same pattern in unauthenticated_controller.rb:25.
findings.fix_sketch: ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(application_token, extracted_token.to_s) with length-equality guard.

findings.title: URI gem CVEs
findings.explanation: bundle-audit reports CVE-2025-27221 (Medium, userinfo leakage in URI#join/merge/+) and CVE-2025-61594 (Unknown, credential-leakage bypass over CVE-2025-27221).
findings.fix_sketch: bundle update uri (target >= 1.0.4 or ~> 0.13.3).

findings.title: Production deploy points at staging bucket and DB
findings.explanation: Production data persists into staging storage; any staging teardown is a prod data event.
findings.fix_sketch: Restore prod env vars; complete Stripe tests on a gated branch.

self_check.notes: Comment found in workflows; needs file-line confirmation before fix.

findings.title: Stripe webhook lacks event-ID dedup
findings.explanation: Signature is verified via Stripe::Webhook.construct_event, but no Event.find_or_create_by(stripe_event_id: event.id) guard. Any new event type added without the inscription_charge? defensive check will double-fire.
findings.fix_sketch: processed_stripe_events table with unique index on stripe_event_id; insert-or-skip at top of handle_event.

findings.title: ApplicationJob retry/discard policies commented out

evidence.snippet:
class ApplicationJob < ActiveJob::Base
  # retry_on ActiveRecord::Deadlocked
  # discard_on ActiveJob::DeserializationError
end

findings.explanation: Every job inherits zero retry safety. Payment jobs (PayInfluencer.perform!) silently lose work on transient Stripe errors.
findings.fix_sketch: Enable both. Add retry_on Net::OpenTimeout, attempts: 5, wait: :exponentially_longer.

findings.title: Zero timeouts on external HTTP calls

evidence.snippet: (grep open_timeout|read_timeout|timeout: returns 0 hits in app/services/ and app/jobs/)

findings.explanation: Faraday default is no timeout. A Stripe/Twilio/GCS slow response hangs the request thread until Puma kills the worker.
findings.fix_sketch: Configure default Faraday connection with open_timeout: 5, read_timeout: 30. Stripe SDK: Stripe.api_request_timeout = 30; Stripe.max_network_retries = 2.

findings.title: update_column(:stripe_customer_id) bypasses callbacks/audit
findings.explanation: A payment-relevant column being written without validations or callbacks. If an audit gem (paper_trail/audited) is added later, this silently skips it.
findings.fix_sketch: @user.update!(stripe_customer_id: customer.id)

findings.title: update_column(:is_blocked) on security-relevant column
findings.explanation: Bypasses callbacks/validations. If an audit log or notification callback is added later, this silently skips it.
findings.fix_sketch: Use update! so future audit/notification callbacks fire. If you genuinely need to skip callbacks, name the helper explicitly.

findings.title: No error tracker / APM in production

evidence.snippet: (no sentry-*, honeybadger, bugsnag, rollbar, ddtrace, newrelic_rpm, skylight, appsignal, opentelemetry-*)

findings.explanation: Errors only surface via Cloud Run logs. No transaction tracing on payment paths.
findings.fix_sketch: Add sentry-ruby + sentry-rails with before_send PII scrubbing as a minimum.

findings.title: No rate limiting
findings.explanation: Login, password reset, signup, and unauthenticated background_jobs/* mass-mutation routes are unbounded.
findings.fix_sketch: Add rack-attack with throttles on auth/*, registration/*, and background_jobs/*.

findings.title: No audit log on money/auth models
findings.explanation: No ledger of who changed is_blocked, subscribed_at, stripe_customer_id, or non_attended_count.
findings.fix_sketch: Add paper_trail on User, Influencer, Brand, Payout, Transaction.

findings.title: Stripe payouts/transfers missing idempotency keys
findings.explanation: A retried payout job creates duplicate Stripe Transfers/Payouts.
findings.fix_sketch: Pass idempotency_key: "payout-#{payout.id}" (stable internal ID) on every Stripe::*.create mutation.

self_check.notes: Agent-reported; needs file re-read before fix.

findings.title: Identity from unverified x-user-id header
findings.explanation: The header value is trusted as-is — no Firebase JWT signature check.
findings.fix_sketch: Verify the Firebase JWT against the JWKS; extract sub from the verified payload. Discard x-user-id.

findings.title: 8 API controllers without request specs

evidence.snippet: (missing for campaigns_controller, brand_controller, influencers_controller, background_jobs_controller, and 4 others)

findings.explanation: Critical surface untested; one regression away from breakage.
findings.fix_sketch: One spec per controller — happy path + auth-failure + one validation case per action.

findings.title: Possible command injection in video versioner
findings.explanation: Backticks with a src_path whose origin chain ultimately includes user-uploaded filenames. The other two Open3.capture3 warnings on lines 142 and 159 are array-form (argv, no shell) — Brakeman false positives.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace backticks with Open3.capture3("ffprobe", "-v", "quiet", "-print_format", "json", "-show_streams", "-show_format", src_path).

findings.title: update_columns(attrs) mass-update on User
findings.explanation: Generic mass-update bypassing validations and callbacks; risky surface for any caller that passes user-influenced attrs.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace with explicit update! calls.

findings.title: No bullet gem — N+1 detection blind
findings.explanation: Without bullet in dev/test, N+1 introductions go unnoticed until production slowdowns.
findings.fix_sketch: Add gem 'bullet' to :development, :test groups; configure Bullet.enable = true in dev.

findings.title: validates_uniqueness count > unique indexes in schema
findings.explanation: Concurrent inserts can both pass model validation, then both succeed in DB.
findings.fix_sketch: Audit each validates_uniqueness; add a corresponding DB-level unique index.

findings.title: Time-sensitive specs use Time.current without freeze
findings.explanation: Will eventually flake at month/year boundaries.
findings.fix_sketch: Wrap timestamp-dependent specs with freeze_time or travel_to.

findings.title: CI builds development Docker target instead of testing

evidence.snippet: tests service uses development build target

findings.explanation: Bloats CI image with dev-only gems; slower feedback loop.
findings.fix_sketch: Switch the tests service to target: testing in docker-compose.yml.
